module autovcoder_099207 (
    sum,
    c_out,
    a,
    b,
    c_in
);

  //Defining i/p and o/p variables
  output [3:0] sum;
  output c_out;
  input [3:0] a, b;
  input c_in;

  //Defining wires for internal signal transfers
  wire w1, w2, w3;

  //Using 1-bit Full Adders to define the logic for a 4-bit Full Adder
  Full_1bit_Adder fa_0 (
      sum[0],
      w1,
      a[0],
      b[0],
      c_in
  );
  Full_1bit_Adder fa_1 (
      sum[1],
      w2,
      a[1],
      b[1],
      w1
  );
  Full_1bit_Adder fa_2 (
      sum[2],
      w3,
      a[2],
      b[2],
      w2
  );
  Full_1bit_Adder fa_3 (
      sum[3],
      c_out,
      a[3],
      b[3],
      w3
  );

endmodule
